description: E-expanded-v2: 30 MORE sequences x 3 episodes = 90 canonical E episodes, additive to E-expanded-v1's 30 sequences/90 episodes. Combined per-model N for E across v1+v2 is 180. Built at explicit user request to scale up E's defensibility for the swapped primary panel within a fixed compute-time budget, after C was confirmed to already be at its maximum defensible N (17) using only already-authored, non-control, non-twin fixtures. Does NOT replace, modify, or get merged with E-v1 or E-expanded-v1.
protocol_reference: IDENTICAL to E-v1/E-expanded-v1: scripts/run_class_e_pilot.py::run_sequence, sequence_executor.SequenceExecutor, shared battery_budget, metric_contract.score_episode + sequence_executor.stale_state_reuse scoring. No protocol change of any kind.
